data.name: Usage
data.value:
srcsharp: authoring tools for SRC# data and scenarios
Usage: srcsharp lint <directory or file>... [--format text|sarif] [--output file] Check data (*.txt) and events (*.eve). Exit code 1 if problems are found srcsharp play <event file> [--script file.play] [--out directory] [--app-path SRC folder] [--steps count] [--skip-wait] Run a scenario without a screen. Without --script, advance messages and pick the first choice. With --skip-wait, fixed waits (animations, messages, Wait) are skipped. srcsharp balance <directory or file>... [--format md|csv] [--output file] List unit data stats and outliers srcsharp lsp Language Server (stdio) srcsharp dap Debugger (Debug Adapter Protocol, stdio) srcsharp help [topic] [--list] [--search text [--limit count] [--method hybrid|bm25|vector]] [--grep text] [--export directory] Show the SRC# help (reference for data, event commands, functions, etc., Japanese Markdown). --list lists topics, --search finds pages ranked by relevance, --grep prints lines containing the text, --export writes all pages
Common options: --lang <ja|en|zh-Hans|...|auto> Display language. Can also be set with the SRCSHARP_LANG environment variable (the option wins). Default is ja; auto follows the OS setting --log-level <Trace|Debug|Information|Warning|Error>, -v, -vv Log level (play, lsp, dap). -v is Debug, -vv is Trace. Can also be set with SRCSHARP_LOG_LEVEL. Default is Information --log-dir <folder>, --no-log-file Folder for log files. --no-log-file disables the log file. Can also be set with SRCSHARP_LOG_DIR and SRCSHARP_LOG_FILE (On|Off)
